ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِيْنَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī arsaltahū Raḥmata ‘l li ‘l-Ālamīn.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the one You sent as a mercy to the Worlds!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَعَلَى سَائِرِ أَنْبِيَآئِكَ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa `alā sā’iri anbiyā’ik.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and all Your Prophets!
